Your presence is the gift. If you'd still like to give something, here are
the two ways to do that. They support different things, so we've kept them
separate.

::: {.card-grid}

::: {.fund-card .honeymoon}
### Honeymoon Fund
We're skipping a traditional registry. If you'd like to contribute toward
our honeymoon, this goes directly toward the trip.

[**Give to the honeymoon fund →**](PASTE_HONEYFUND_LINK_HERE){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::

::: {.fund-card .roomboard}
### Room & Board
If you're staying with us on-property, this is a voluntary way to help
cover the cost of your stay. Entirely optional, no pressure either way.

[**Contribute to room & board →**](PASTE_ROOMBOARD_LINK_HERE){.btn .btn-outline-primary}
:::
